description: Postal code lookup for 60+ countries (US, CA, GB, DE, FR, ES, IT, BR, AR, IN, JP, AU and more): the places that share the code with state or region, state code and coordinates. Mexican codes have their own richer endpoint (/api/v1/cp). Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
